pivots.to: AI agents for ERP implementation teams
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page shows the earlier launch as an open-source proxy and the current product as ERP implementation agents

target_customer: ERP implementation teams at VARs, advisory firms and systems integrators (earlier, developers needing API integrations)
problem: ERP implementations and API integrations require slow manual data mapping, migration and configuration.
product_category: AI agents for ERP implementation (originally open-source integration proxy)

founders.name: Stefan Faistenauer
founders.background_notes: Former software engineer per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM generated transformation code with self-healing is manageable; ERP connectors and safe execution add hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and approved migration scripts create some stickiness, but agents and connectors are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Integration platforms and ERP vendors added AI agents; Sage Intacct listed superglue on its marketplace in August 2026.

market_need_then: Integration code was costly to build per API, and open-source plus LLM approaches drew developer interest at the W25 launch.

identity.visual_style: Vintage computer header image with chat-style product preview

branding.brand_signature: Glue metaphor for connecting any system
branding.community_and_virality: Open-source GitHub repo; no merch or fan activity found.

brand_strength.rationale: Metaphoric name fits the integration job, but it is common (super glue the adhesive) and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: superglue started in Winter 2025 as an open-source LLM-based integration proxy and moved to AI agents for ERP implementation firms, winning a Sage Intacct marketplace listing and an accounting partnership by 2026. Funding is not credibly verified, though aggregators show about 500 thousand dollars with YC, so strength of the fundraising story is unknown.
notes: Funding aggregators conflict (ZoomInfo/VCBacked about 500K with YC, PitchBook lists a March 2025 seed with eight investors, CB Insights shows a 2022 seed that predates founding, tech.eu 5.1M not tied to superglue), so no round recorded. No dated competitor source near the batch was found (Nango comparisons are 2026), so the competitor list is empty. Pivot date approximate. Completeness pass: the 2025-03 seed of 500K rests on a single database (Caplight; VCBacked says pre-seed, PitchBook dates a seed 2025-03-10 with other investors). No press or primary confirmation found.
